The '''Graph 18 Surface Locator''' was a [[directional transponder]] used for orientation on a [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] surface.. The transponder is able to locate itself by examining [[Star map/Legends|star-charts]] and measuring [[Star/Legends|solar]] and [[Moon/Legends|lunar]] degrees, as well as determine planetary north and south.<ref name="Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref> The unit contained over 25,000 planetary maps and could update by connecting to [[Alliance masternav|Alliance MasterNav]].<ref name="Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook" /> Roughly the size of a briefcase, the transponder could also be connected directly to a [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] [[Droid brain/Legends|brain]].
